title: Strict IPv4 parsing
description: Implement parse_ipv4(text). Return a tuple of four ints for a valid dotted-quad IPv4 address, else None. Exactly four decimal fields separated by single dots; each 0-255; only ASCII digits; no signs, spaces or empty fields; leading zeros are rejected unless the field is exactly '0'.
invariants: No whitespace, signs or non-ASCII digits.
